factual_claims.claim: TKM Grupp AS reported a weaker financial performance in 2025 amid difficult economic conditions and intense retail competition.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The year 2025 will go down in history as a year of a challenging economic environment and major challenges for Estonian retailers in general and for TKM Group in particular. Consumer confidence remained low due to both the uncertain geopolitical situation and domestic tax changes. Competition in retail trade remained intense and consumer price sensitivity high.

candidate_sentences.text: TKM Grupp AS reported a weaker financial performance in 2025 amid difficult economic conditions and intense retail competition.

factual_claims.claim: The report explicitly links this decline to Estonia's motor vehicle tax, uncertainty before its introduction and reduced consumer confidence.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The motor vehicle tax introduced in Estonia during the reporting year and the resulting sharp decrease in demand led to a significant contraction in new passenger car sales, with total car sales in Estonia declining by 48.6% for the year and by as much as 62.4% in the fourth quarter.

candidate_sentences.text: The report explicitly links this decline to Estonia’s motor vehicle tax, uncertainty before its introduction and reduced consumer confidence.

factual_claims.claim: New passenger-car sales in Estonia fell 48.6% for the year and 62.4% in the fourth quarter, although stronger markets in Latvia and Lithuania partly offset the decline.

factual_claims.source_evidence: According to AMTEL data, 13,055 new passenger cars were sold in Estonia in 2025, which was 48.6% below the level of 2024. At the same time, sales of new passenger cars increased by 31.4% in Latvia and by 39.3% in Lithuania.

candidate_sentences.text: Supermarket revenue was broadly stable, increasing 0.3% to €611.9 million, but net profit fell 38.6% to €9.5 million.

Financial performance in the final quarter of the year was negatively affected by the renovation and expansion of Jõgeva Selver, which involved one-off additional costs and a temporary suspension of sales activities.
